title: Tech view: the Estimate column shows the Tech Time value
preconds:
1. A user has a role with View mode set to Tech view.
  2. A test work order has an Estimate value and a different Tech Time value.
steps:
1. Log in as that user and open Work Orders.
  2. Open the test work order.
  3. Look at the Estimate column on the lines.
  4. Compare with what a Full View user sees.
expected: The Estimate column shows the Tech Time value, not the money estimate value.
